title: steamer worthless
text: steamer worthless. I bought this a few months ago and just got it open to try it on some very very sheer curtains (meaning SUPER lightweight).  First, the steam lasted about 6 minutes, after filled just to the max fill line.  Second, the steam did NOTHING on the curtains.  Seriously.  It didn't even look like I had done ANYTHING to them.  The old saying... you get what you pay for .... really applies.  I just wanted something easy to use.  DON'T waste your money!  I will be taking the curtains down and doing a good, old fashioned light iron.  Sigh.  Just a note.... I do NOT receive compensation of ANY kind for my reviews.  Period.  My reviews are on VERIFIED, full price, independent purchases.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. In this case, the steamer went right into the trash bin.  Grrrrrrrr

product_metadata.title: E4U 900 Watt Handheld Fabric Steamer with Elite Travel Case, Black
features: UNLIKE OTHER HANDHELD STEAMERS: The E4U Wrinkler Remover is both POWERFULL AND GENTLE. The E4U Steamers were tested at a 900 Watt rating, other Steamers are powered by only 800 or 850 Watts.

SAFE ON FABRICS: Steaming is gentle alternative to standard pressure ironing. Gentle on natural fabrics, furniture, garments, linens, textiles, cotton, and wool. Note: Not Ideal for Synthetic Materials.
WORK SMARTER NOT HARDER: when using the E4U Steamer you can quickly remove wrinkles while clothes are still on a hanger.

There is a better way there is another option to conventional ironing, introducing the E4U fabric steamer. These steamers are lightweight and hand-held, they are a great user friendly variation of the traditional large commercial fabric steamers. The E4U steamer removes wrinkles on all types of fabrics: Cotton polyester/synthetics drapery linens furniture delicates and more safer than a heavy conventional iron, the E4U steamer has no exposed heating elements so there is no need to worry about burning yourself, loved ones and children. These safety measures are paired with professional grade solid aluminum heating that backed with now with 900 watts of power, (the average steamer has 800 “ 850 watts). Easily remove wrinkles in the comfort of your own home or while on the go. We want to thank you: Every order gets the zippered travel case which is not only perfect for the fabric steamer but can double as a cosmetics case. The case has an accessory pocket and bonus travel mirror. Plus: As an extra thank you you will get the exclusive E4U eBook: Chemical free cleaning, tips on making your own natural cleaning products. After clicking the buy button you are not only on your way to being fabulous and wrinkle free, but you are gaining the support of the E4U team who is always eager to answer you product related questions. Drip-free 120 ml/5 oz.
